newsitem.title: LATVIA: SHIPPING CO TO GET TWO NEW GAS TANKERS -REPORT.
newsitem.headline: SHIPPING CO TO GET TWO NEW GAS TANKERS -REPORT.

text.p: The Latvian Shipping company is set to launch a new gas tanker and plans to receive another in July, newspaper Bizness i Baltija said on Tuesday.

Both tankers, Kurzeme and Vidzeme, have been built in South Korea and will cost the company around $100 million, Ilze Lachgale, head of the firm's marketing department was quoted by the newspaper as saying.
Latvian Shipping, estimated to be the world's 19th largest shipping firm, has 39 tankers, 24 refrigerated vessels and seven dry-cargo vessels. Its turnover is close to $300 million.
The new gas tankers are expected to be operated together with Norwegian Larsen Westfalen Shipping AS.
Kurzeme will take some 20,500 cubic metres of liquified gas and will be able to hold three types of cargo at the same time, Lachgale was reported as saying.
